name: memory
summary: Three-tier memory: a short router file loaded every session, per-project session memory, and an archive plus one log per session; /log and /checkpoint commands; a pre-compact stub hook.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (compact stubs are written under it)
env.MEMORY_DIR: absolute path of the memory folder; default ~/.claude/projects/<folder slug>/memory
env.TICKET_RE: optional pattern for a ticket id in the stub, default L- plus four digits

notes: Run python3 ~/.claude/hubkit/memory/memory_init.py once to create MEMORY.md, ARCHIVE.md, conversations_index.md and conversations/. Commands are copied to ~/.claude/commands only if the name is free.
